text:
Miriam K: Quick design review — prompt sets compare + approval flow. Pushed an updated Figma here: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234 Prompt: we need clearer affordances for the regression diff and an accessible approval modal. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/xyz. Key areas I want feedback on: 1) diff gutter layout; 2) approval CTA copy; 3) scorecard weighting visibility; 4) keyboard flow. PTAL 🙏

Devin R: Love the diff idea but the red used for deletions doesn't meet contrast for AA with the bg. Also we don't show a visible focus ring when tabbing through diffs — that's needed. I'll drop proposed color swatches in the figma comments.

Ash Patel: +1 on contrast. On accessibility: each diff row should be a button with aria-expanded, and the content should be reachable by screen readers. Also we should add an aria-live region so new diffs announce when they appear.

Miriam K: Proposed modal copy (snippet):
```
Heading: Approve prompt set
Body: This will promote the prompt set to production for the selected model variants. You can add notes for the rollout.
Buttons: [Approve & Promote] [Request changes]
Optional: dropdown 'Approve with notes'
```

Sam O'Neill: From PM: add an "Approve with notes" flow so reviewers can capture rationale. Also the scorecard summary should be prominent at the top of the modal (pass % / regressions) — right now it's buried in the right rail and gets ignored.

DesignBot: regression-eval-bot: New regression detected for prompt-set #53 — overall quality metric down 12%. Report: https://infradash/reports/53

Devin R: For copy, "Approve & Promote" is fine but we need a shorter label for keyboard users. Suggest keeping primary CTA as "Promote" and use tooltip to expand to "Approve & Promote". Also, add keyboard shortcut 'A' to trigger approve when modal focused. Tooltip should say "Press A to Promote".

Ash Patel: Modal ARIA notes: role=\"dialog\" with aria-labelledby referencing the heading id, aria-describedby pointing at the scorecard summary. The approve button should have aria-live updates while rollout is in progress (status: queued -> in-progress -> done). Also confirm the dropdown for "Approve with notes" uses accessible combobox patterns, not a custom aria-unsafe widget.

Miriam K: Decision notes: change deletion color to something with better contrast (Devin, please propose two hex options), change primary CTA to read visually as "Approve & Promote" but label as "Promote" for compact UI and keyboard shortcuts. Add a small scorecard summary (pass % / regression count) at the top of the approval modal. Keep "Request changes" as the secondary CTA. Add a dropdown option for "Approve with notes".

Sam O'Neill: I'll update the acceptance criteria in INF-1023: include keyboard nav, focus ring, aria labels, CTA copy, scorecard summary placement, and the "approve with notes" UX. I'll also ask data to surface top 3 regression examples in the modal. Ticket: https://jira/redwood/browse/INF-1023

Devin R: I'll post color swatches + focus-ring specs in the figma comments and add CSS snippets for the team. Quick CSS example I'll use for focus ring: 
```
.diff-item:focus { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 2px; }
```

Ash Patel: I'll draft the ARIA attributes and a short testing script for QA (screen reader checks + keyboard-only flow). Will also validate that aria-live announcements don't spam on incremental diffs.

Miriam K: Great. Action items: @Devin R - colors + focus ring + CSS; @Ash Patel - ARIA copy + QA script; @Sam O'Neill - PM acceptance + ticket updates; @Miriam K - update figma copy variants and add comment threads for copy choices. Goal: have a first interactive prototype in staging next week. :thumbsup:

DesignBot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment to staging scheduled for 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC. No blockers reported.

Devin R: noted and assigning time to mock up the color variants.

Sam O'Neill: thanks all — will sync with design tomorrow 10:00am PT.
